title.narrative: Sexual and reproductive health and rights promotion among adolescents

description.narrative: The pilot project is aimed at increasing knowledge on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights in Morogoro and Dar es Salaam regions in Tanzania. Other aims include obtaining baseline data on knowledge, attitudes and practices related to Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights among adolescents in Morogoro along with assessing the specific gaps of knowledge in the region. The activities to be conducted include workshops on data collection, evaluation and interpretation, development of research kits for volunteers. Workshops regarding communication, advocacy and advertising about SRHR through Abood FM radio in Morogoro region will also be conducted. Other advocacy activities to be conducted include speed mentoring sessions in Dar es Salaam together with TAMIDA day. The target group for the activities are adolescents aged 12 to 19 years including students in secondary schools in Dar es Salaam and Morogoro region together with the TAMIDA volunteers and the teachers.
